mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This character has Ricochet auto attacks and enhanced attack speed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>On The Hunt</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for @Effect1Amount@ seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores <healing>@TotalHeal@ health</healing> and triggers Fleet of Foot.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This shield blocks both champion and item Abilities.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir's Attacks and Abilities grant her a burst of @FlatMS@ Decaying Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds when they damage enemy champions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Fleet of Foot</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@</physicalDamage> to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @FallOffMinimum*100@%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return.
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
Cast time scales down with Attack Speed

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them @MaxMS*100@% Move Speed for @UltDuration@ seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ricochet</titleLeft><mainText>Sivir's basic attacks will bounce to nearby targets beyond the first, dealing reduced damage to secondary targets.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, Sivir gains @RicochetAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing @BounceDamage@ physical damage each bounce for up to @MaxBounces@ bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Bounces will prioritize new targets before returning to targets that have already been struck. Can only hit each target a maximum of two times.
Bounces deal @MinionDamageMod*100@% damage to minions.
This ability executes low Health minions.
